body: Split/bonus-adjusted ₹3.9 (Jan 2009) → ATH ₹2,099 (Jan 2018) ≈540x. In the measurable 2012–18 leg (19x), standalone P/E rose 15 → 84 (5.5x) × implied EPS ~3.5x, so about 58% was rerating. Early signal (narrative partly unverified): after a mid-2000s turnaround it became the asset-light, outsourced leader in branded air coolers, with OPM 25–31% and ROCE ~50% (screener FY15–18). The stock went 10x in 2009–10 alone. Ended: EPS was flat at ~₹17–23 for FY17–FY23 while P/E stayed 50–75 (weather-dependent single category, more competition, overseas acquisitions in Mexico and Australia). FY26: consolidated net loss ~₹141 cr after a ₹173 cr goodwill impairment on the Australian business (Climate Holdings) plus ₹35 cr PPE/intangible impairments; standalone loss ₹166 cr after a ₹298 cr investment write-down. The stock fell −77% to ₹491 (Oct 2026); ₹554 on 19 Nov 2026. Lesson: a seasonal single-product franchise at 80x with flat EPS, plus foreign acquisitions, gives a long bear market. Watch for EPS stagnation at a premium P/E, and capital allocation outside the core.

data.ended: flat EPS at 50-80x; Australia impairments FY26
data.lesson: diworsification + flat EPS at premium P/E
data.note: Prices: screener.in weekly closes, split/bonus-adjusted. P/E = trailing (TTM); implied EPS x = price multiple / P/E multiple.

title: Symphony 2009–2018: air-cooler leader ~540x, then an 8-year −77% bear
